dct_description_sm: This record covers single maps of the Boston region, which are not represented in the LC database by separate catalog records. This collection includes single printed maps and may also include some multi-sheet single maps, and plates from atlases, books or periodicals. To request a specific map or for more information, contact a reference librarian in the Geography & Map Division (202) 707-6277 or through the "Ask a librarian" link through the Geography & Map Division website https://ask.loc.gov/map-geography/.
